notice: Synthetic evidence for deterministic offline contracts; not real literature findings or an LLM quality benchmark.

cases.name: opd
cases.query: 帮我调研一下 On-Policy Distillation (OPD)
sources: Synthetic fixture. On-policy training samples trajectories from the current student. Teacher feedback supervises student-visited prefixes. A divergence objective measures teacher/student distributions. Fixed offline training uses a predefined corpus. No benchmark scores are provided.
Synthetic fixture. Online sampling adds rollout cost. Comparing approaches requires the same teacher, student, dataset and rollout budget. Neither source establishes superiority on all tasks.
cases.analysis: 共同问题是训练与推理所遇前缀的差异；在线采样与固定语料是不同策略。目标函数和采样预算需要分开比较，不能给出全任务排名。
cases.paragraph: On-policy 方法使用当前学生采样的轨迹，因此监督覆盖学生实际到达的前缀；固定语料方法使用预先确定的数据。[1] 两者不能只按名称比较性能，还需控制教师、学生和采样预算。[2]

cases.name: two_papers
cases.query: 深入比较论文 A 与论文 B 的方法和实验条件
titles: 论文 A：规则网格算子
论文 B：边界残差约束
sources: Synthetic fixture. Paper A learns a data-driven operator on a regular grid. Error is 0.08 on Dataset X using 100 labeled trajectories. Changed boundary conditions were not evaluated.

Synthetic fixture. Paper B imposes a differential residual at collocation points with 10 labeled trajectories. Error is 0.04 on Dataset Y. Dataset Y has different geometry and boundary conditions from X.
headings: 适用条件和待验证问题
cases.analysis: A 借助标签学习算子，B 引入残差约束；数据集和边界条件不同，不能由误差数字推导优劣。
cases.paragraph: A 使用标注轨迹学习算子，B 利用微分残差补充少量标签。[1][2] 两篇论文采用不同数据集和边界条件，不能把报告误差直接作为优劣排名。

cases.name: field_review
cases.query: 综述 AI4CFD 领域的主要技术路线及局限
sources: Synthetic fixture. Operator learning amortizes repeated solutions across training parameter distributions. Accuracy depends on representative samples; out-of-distribution geometries are not evaluated.

Synthetic fixture. Residual models incorporate governing equations and boundary constraints. Optimization depends on residual weighting and collocation sampling; no universal accuracy guarantee exists.
Synthetic fixture. Hybrid solvers combine numerical discretization with learned corrections. Cost includes both components. Hardware and accuracy targets must be aligned for speed comparisons.
cases.analysis: 三条路线强调数据分布、方程约束和数值结构；成本与泛化瓶颈不同，不能脱离误差目标和硬件比较速度。
cases.paragraph: 算子学习将多次求解成本摊销到训练阶段，残差方法引入方程约束，混合方法保留数值离散结构。[1][2][3] 这种分类解释了不同适用条件；速度和精度需在共同设置下验证。
